defect: SQUARE COLLAR FAMILY — blueprints depict POINT collars
summary: Options whose label and description specify a squared-off collar termination are backed by reference images showing sharp acute POINT tips. Because every QC score measures fidelity TO the blueprint, faithful renders of these wrong drawings score 98+ and PASS — two did, and both have been revoked.

confirmedWrong.label: Square 6.5 cm with Button
confirmedWrong.evidence: sharp acute point tips, verified visually

confirmedWrong.label: Small Square 5.0 cm
confirmedWrong.evidence: sharp pointed tips on long leaves, verified visually

confirmedWrong.label: Small Square 5.0 cm with Button
confirmedWrong.evidence: acute apex, edge-stitch meets in a V, leaves far longer than 5.0 cm

confirmedWrong.label: Small Square 5.0 cm Zigzag
confirmedWrong.evidence: single sharp acute point at 5x zoom; only the zigzag topstitch matches

confirmedCorrect.label: Square 6.5 cm
confirmedCorrect.evidence: genuine flat squared-off terminal edge — proves the catalog CAN represent square ends, so the others are mis-sourced files, not a terminology difference

fix: Supply correct square-tip tech packs for the four confirmed-wrong options, then regenerate. Until then they stay in needs-source.
correctionToEarlierDiagnosis: An earlier hypothesis blamed a presentation mismatch (garment-only reference vs a worn-on-model prompt) for the square-tip failures. That was WRONG for this family: the references themselves show point collars, so the model was reproducing them faithfully. The garment-only presentation change remains justified on its own merits (it removes the face/jaw intrusion QC flagged repeatedly) but it was not the cause here.

RESOLVED.correction: This report originally concluded that NO authoritative drawing existed for the square family. That was WRONG. A dedicated supplier tech-pack library exists at /images/techpacks/** (485 line drawings, byte-identical mirrors of /images/lapel/ etc.), and it contains square-in-65cm.jpg, square-in-65cm-with-button.jpg, small-square-in-5cm.jpg and small-square-in-5cm-with-button.jpg. The catalog was simply pointing techpackIllustration at each option aiImage (an AI PHOTO) instead of at the drawing.
RESOLVED.action: Re-pointed 51 of the 55 AI-photo-blueprinted options at their real tech-pack drawing (exact token-set match, 0 ambiguous, all 51 verified to exist on disk). The square family can now be regenerated against authoritative geometry.
RESOLVED.stillManualReason: Near-miss filenames (e.g. "Square Stand (No Button)" vs square-stand-collar-without-button.jpg). Left unmatched deliberately rather than guessed - picking the wrong drawing is the exact failure this exercise exists to prevent.
